ImageDescription.value:
Peter Andreas Thiel, aka Peter Thiel, is a venture capitalist who co-founded PayPal and is currently president of Clarium Capital, a global macro hedge fund. Thiel is one of the radical billionaires trying to buy the 2012 election for corporate interests.
